title: 宝塚記念の後に・春のグランプリ制覇！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan claims victory at the Takarazuka Kinen and shouts her joy out to the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen congratulates and entrusts her with competing in medium-distance races for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …She also expresses a desire for Ryan to become an exquisite lady by the time of their next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Becoming a proper lady by the year-end Arima Kinen means Mejiro Ryan will be as busy as ever.
